prompts.terrain-prompt.txt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a two-material terrain texture atlas for a smooth painted 2D African-inspired savanna adventure game, slightly elevated top-down camera. ONE wide image split exactly down its middle into TWO equal rectangular panels filling their entire halves, with no margin, no gap and no borders. LEFT HALF: seamless, evenly lit muted olive-green savanna ground with soft mossy grass brushwork and sparse fine golden blades, natural mottling at small scale. RIGHT HALF: seamless warm ochre sandy footpath ground with finely brushed compacted earth, a few tiny scattered pebbles and very faint worn footpath grain. Both textures should read as flat ground seen from above, with cohesive polished hand-painted adventure-game shading and restrained texture contrast. Every panel fully opaque edge-to-edge, no horizon, no perspective recession, no large objects, no bushes, no trees, no people, no UI, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no vignettes, no directional gradients, no shadows. Each material is intended to tile across a large 2D level; opposite panel edges should match. The brushwork should complement warm rust-red woven robes and gold/cream character sprites without overwhelming them. Use a landscape 3:2 canvas; the two materials each fill exactly half the canvas width.
prompts.props-prompt.txt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: environment prop atlas for a smooth hand-painted 2D African-inspired savanna adventure game, to match polished painted character sprites, not pixel art, not 3D rendering. Create exactly SIX isolated props on a genuinely transparent background in an exact THREE-COLUMN TWO-ROW equal SQUARE-cell grid on a 3:2 canvas. Every item completely contained within its own cell with generous 15 percent margins. Reading order: (1) mature baobab tree with a thick warm grey-brown trunk and rounded olive-green canopy, (2) spreading acacia tree with a gracefully asymmetric broad flat ochre-green crown, (3) compact cluster of warm grey basalt and russet rocks, (4) tuft of golden savanna grass with small olive leaves, (5) a small grouping of two rustic terracotta water jars beside a folded woven ochre/rust mat, (6) a simple weathered carved wooden trail post with a blank directional plank and short base stones. Individual props in a front three-quarter slightly elevated orthographic-style view, appropriate for placing beside a winding top-down trail. Warm sunlight from upper left, clear silhouettes, subtle dark brown contours, broad readable painted shapes, no photoreal textures. Keep all tree roots, crowns, stones, grass tips and jar bottoms visible. No ground patches, ground plane, scenic backdrops, lettering, labels, borders, painted checkerboards, cast shadows, people, animals, ruins, fantasy symbols, or duplicate items. All empty space must be real transparent alpha. The baobab and acacia will be taller than a 96px standing person, the other props much smaller; each should nevertheless fill roughly 65-70 percent of its own cell for extraction.

limits: Tutorial dialogue, battles and the Stage 1-2 transition are intentionally inactive.
Character art retains its existing sprite QA notes.
